claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: Not coded (abstract only). The abstract reports that jointly optimized fabric-reinforced laminates are up to 43.8% stiffer than counterparts made with planar fabric plies, in simulation and physical tests; no classical-optimizer comparison is stated.
